items.name: Spec compliance
items.note: Operator asked to act on the open item 'turn on the weekly schedule'. schedule cron '0 6 * * 1' is active, workflow_dispatch kept, pull_request kept commented out, DORMANT header replaced with an accurate description.

items.name: Error handling
items.note: Trigger change only; the critical gate and fail-closed logic are untouched.

items.name: Security basics
items.note: No action added or re-pinned, permissions block unchanged. Scheduled runs skip the PR-comment steps (guarded on event_name == pull_request) and upload SARIF as workflow_dispatch already does. Repo is public, so Code Scanning upload works.

items.name: Test quality
items.note: actionlint clean; YAML parses to on={schedule:[cron '0 6 * * 1'], workflow_dispatch}; lint/build/392 unit tests green. A workflow_dispatch run on the branch will confirm GitHub accepts the file.

items.name: Performance basics
items.note: One ~1 min CI run per week.

items.name: Naming & structure
items.note: Header comment corrected during self-review: it first claimed an expired .trivyignore entry fails the run; the gate only blocks CVSS>=9.0 or secrets, so the comment now says the finding is reported again. Removed the pointer to the nonexistent docs/security-ci-setup.md.

items.name: Affected boundaries
items.note: Consumer: refresh_ci_security.py reads the latest security.yml run regardless of trigger, so scheduled runs feed the compliance security summary.
